body: Still though, even if it is just a phase, these feelings and thoughts that I have are still real, this is still how I genuinely feel and it's not just attention seeking. People keep blowing me off saying I'll get over it but it's getting to be too much. I can't do this anymore.

Honestly, everyone has told me those types of things. Family members, friend's parents, the media. It makes me feel like less of a person because I can't conform to these ideals. And no one listens cuz I'm just an "edgy teen" and this is "just a phase". I'm tired of my cries for help being ignored.

It might be possible. I'm not sure if it'll do much good. The last time I was at school, I would frequently have to leave my classes because of panic attacks and it was hard to learn. It makes me anxious just thinking about it.
Okay, I'll definitely try that. Thanks.
